name: PAR Punchh
oneLiner: Enterprise loyalty, offers and guest engagement platform for restaurant chains, owned by PAR Technology and part of its PAR Engagement cloud.
bestFor: Multi-unit and enterprise restaurant brands that want loyalty tied into POS, ordering and guest data.

updates.text: PAR launched PAR Engagement, a unified guest engagement cloud combining Punchh loyalty, marketing and offers, rebuilt PAR Ordering and guest data; the release added membership tiers and AI-driven rule activation.
PAR unveiled Smart Passes, wallet-native loyalty in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet with one-tap enrollment and real-time points and offers, synced with Punchh campaigns.

features: Points, visit and tiered membership programs
Offers and campaign engine with segmentation and AI-driven rule activation
Smart Passes: loyalty cards in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet without an app
PAR Games: gamified loyalty experiences natively integrated with Punchh
Integrations with POS, online ordering, mobile apps and kiosks
Guest data and reporting across channels as part of PAR Engagement
notes: Punchh was acquired by PAR Technology (reported $500M, 2021) and is sold as PAR Punchh within PAR Engagement. Dropped original claims: 'over 40% of top 100 US restaurant brands', 'up to 6.5x frequency lift' from Punchh Wallet, '100%+ net dollar retention', Yum!/TGI Friday's/Casey's as customers (not re-verified). Brand count varies by source (200+ vs 275+), so left out. PAR Games launch date not confirmed. punchh.com and businesswire.com could not be fetched; facts come from search results of the releases. November 2026: punchh.com now opens as PAR Engagement ('PAR Punchh is now part of PAR Engagement'), lists no prices and offers demos; it claims 'Trusted by over 275 global brands' and '34/100 Top Restaurant Brands'. G2 rating from search snippets of g2.com/products/par-punchh/reviews: 2.6 from only 10 reviews, several from 2018 to 2020, so a thin and dated sample.
pros: Built for restaurant chains: loyalty, offers and guest data tied into POS, online ordering, apps and kiosks
Flexible program types: points, visits and membership tiers
Wallet loyalty without an app: Smart Passes in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet
One vendor for loyalty, marketing, ordering and guest data through PAR Engagement
Scale: punchh.com says it is trusted by over 275 global brands

cons.text: No published prices; you talk to PAR's team for a quote
Built for multi-unit and enterprise brands, so a single-location restaurant may not need its depth

rating.note: Only 10 reviews, several from 2018 to 2020; too thin to cite in a review.
